headline: Strong execution; margin recovery remains monitorable

highlights: Revenue growth was supported by improved execution, easing supply-side constraints and stabilisation of the indigenous supply chain, with Rail & Metro accounting for ~40% of revenue.
H1FY27 order inflows stood at ~INR74bn, led by Rail & Metro (~75%), followed by Defence (~13%) and Mining & Exports (~12%).

Inflows were supported by the large NHSRCL order (~INR54bn) for high-speed rolling stock secured during the quarter, taking the order book to ~INR214bn (4.4x TTM revenue) and providing strong revenue visibility.

Within Rail & Metro, the company has an opportunity pipeline of ~INR60bn in metro rolling stock tenders and expects another INR30–40bn of inflows from commuter rail, while Defence offers additional opportunities through armoured recovery vehicle overhauling and combat engineering orders.
valuation: Against this backdrop, the company is targeting FY27 order inflows of ~INR200bn, with the balance ~INR126bn expected in H2FY27, led by Rail & Metro (~50%), followed by Defence (~30%) and Mining & Exports (~20%).
The company is targeting an export order book of ~US$200mn by FY27-end, with exports expected to contribute 6–7% of FY27 revenue.
We roll forward to Sep’28E and maintain our ‘Accumulate’ rating with a revised TP of INR2,225 (INR2,011 earlier), at PE multiple of 26x Sep’28E (27x Mar’28E).
watch: FY27 revenue growth guidance has been revised to 35%+, while timely order conversion and input costs remain key monitorables.
Mining equipment, Exports and Commuter Rail are expected to be key margin drivers, supported by conversion of long-lead items.
